title: A/P Detail: a long bucket loads in 100s with no line repeated or skipped
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • One aging bucket, {Bucket-A}, has between 101 and 400 open lines on today's date.
    For example: {Bucket-A} is "91 or more days past due".
  • Starting screen: A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with every bucket collapsed.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
  2. Count the CSV rows whose bucket is {Bucket-A}.
  3. Expand {Bucket-A} and scroll to its end, letting every batch load, writing down each document number.
  4. Click the "Amount" header.
  5. Scroll to the end of {Bucket-A} again (expand it if it closed), writing down each number.
  6. Compare the two lists with the CSV.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the CSV downloads.
  • Step 2: note the count (for example 250).
  • Step 3: the first 100 lines show, then more load as you scroll; every document appears exactly once.
  • Step 4: the rows sort by Amount, largest first, inside each bucket.
  • Step 5: in this sort too, every document appears exactly once.
  • Step 6: both lists hold exactly the CSV's documents for {Bucket-A}: none repeated, none missing.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order), story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows)

  • S1-R8: “paging stated per report (30 customers or vendors per page on the Summaries, A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices; 100 lines per bucket, then scroll, on the Detail reports). S4-R4: the 100-lines-then-scroll rule now covers A/R Detail too.”
  • S4-R4: “On A/R Detail and A/P Detail, expanding a bucket (by hand or with Expand all) shows its first 100 lines, then loads more as the user scrolls. This is as today on A/P Detail and new on A/R Detail, which today shows a whole bucket at once.”
